description: Source code for a custom Qt widget QMarkdownTextEdit, which extends QPlainTextEdit to support markdown editing features such as syntax highlighting, link handling, bracket auto-completion, indentation, and custom event filtering.

classes.name: QMarkdownTextEdit
classes.description: A custom Qt widget extending QPlainTextEdit to support markdown editing with syntax highlighting, link handling, bracket auto-completion, indentation, and event filtering.

methods.name: QMarkdownTextEdit::QMarkdownTextEdit
methods.description: Constructor initializing the markdown text editor, setting up event filters, layout, highlighter, search widget, and default options.

methods.name: setHighlightingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables markdown syntax highlighting.

methods.name: adjustRightMargin
methods.description: Adjusts the right margin to prevent search buttons from being blocked by the scrollbar.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Handles various UI events such as hover, key press, key release, and mouse button release for custom behaviors.

methods.name: resetMouseCursor
methods.description: Resets the cursor to the default I-beam cursor.

methods.name: focusOutEvent
methods.description: Resets cursor when the widget loses focus.

methods.name: handleBracketClosing
methods.description: Automatically inserts matching closing brackets or characters.

methods.name: bracketClosingCheck
methods.description: Checks whether to insert a closing bracket based on context.

methods.name: handleBracketRemoval
methods.description: Removes matching brackets or markdown characters when backspace is pressed.

methods.name: increaseSelectedTextIndention
methods.description: Indents or un-indents selected text or current line.

methods.name: openLinkAtCursorPosition
methods.description: Opens the URL at the current cursor position if valid.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper URL.

methods.name: openUrl
methods.description: Opens a URL using the system's default handler.

methods.name: highlighter
methods.description: Returns the markdown syntax highlighter instance.

methods.name: searchWidget
methods.description: Returns the search widget instance.

methods.name: setIgnoredClickUrlSchemata
methods.description: Sets URL schemata to ignore when clicking links.

methods.name: parseMarkdownUrlsFromText
methods.description: Parses and extracts markdown URLs from text.

methods.name: getMarkdownUrlAtPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the markdown URL at a specific cursor position.

methods.name: duplicateText
methods.description: Duplicates selected text or current line.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the editor.

methods.name: setPlainText
methods.description: Sets plain text content, clearing highlighter dirty blocks and adjusting margins.

methods.name: initSearchFrame
methods.description: Initializes the search widget within a specified parent frame.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the editor and search widget.

methods.name: handleReturnEntered
methods.description: Handles behavior when Enter key is pressed, such as list continuation or removal.

methods.name: handleTabEntered
methods.description: Handles indentation or un-indentation when Tab or Shift+Tab is pressed.

methods.name: setAutoTextOptions
methods.description: Sets options for auto-insertion of brackets, indentation, etc.

methods.name: paintEvent
methods.description: Overrides paint event to fix RTL text layout issues.
